name: cdp5-gates
description: Deterministic read-only T1 skills per CDP5 §32.9: decidable, repeated detectors as Node programs instead of LLM agents (konzept-lint with the shipped maturity policy, mcp-config-lint, secrets-scan, pii-scan, skill-lint and more). One exit-code and severity convention; every report is reproducible evidence the main agent acts on.
